data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a mail draft that is discarded) and has the right country and client parameters. It is vague about GDP with its year and the growth value (it only says "read population and other indicators", with no scroll to GDP growth), and it gives no concrete recipient format ({client}@example.com). It also lists the extracted values as parameters, so an automation would need guesswork to build it.
